findings.reason: the constant the node writes is the deliverable, so an incomplete list ships the regression the section exists to remove, and adding `node.role` and `node.spec_level` also changes what done-when case 1 and case 3 can assert.
findings.text: s17's steerable list (goal, done-when, negative control, write paths, inputs, time budget, dispatch options, brief fields) omits `node.role` and `node.spec_level`, both of which `crew dispatch` accepts on the same invocation (`reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:1146` `--spec-level`, and `--role`) and neither of which appears in `_node_identity` (`reckon/crew/runs.py:429-444`, which keys on plan/section/node id only), so a re-dispatch that changes a queued request's role or spec level still finds the existing pointer and — under a merge of only the listed fields — silently keeps the old value; today's whole-record overwrite applies it, so the specified fix regresses that case and reproduces the section's own failure mode (a coordinator's steer silently discarded) one field over

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `queue_dispatch` is at `reckon/crew/runs.py:686` with the whole-record write at `runs.py:770`; `base_sha` and `argv` are written into the pointer at `dispatch.py:2979` and `dispatch.py:3234`; `dispatch_sessions.observe` writes `record["session_id"]` (`dispatch_sessions.py:290`); `queue_admission.py` near 3377 is the hold/release `_mutate_pointer` path a held-and-released request passes through.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — s17's done-when names four measurable cases and a declared negative control ("restores the whole-record overwrite, and the first case fails") that targets the first case, so the measure can fail.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the only artifact named is a repository test file, `tests/test_a_redispatch_keeps_the_queued_identity.py`, which survives the run; no gate log is directed at a scratchpad or node-local path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag reaches the new constant, the test filename or the section's prose.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the mechanism matches the cited code, but the steerable-field list it makes binding omits node fields the re-dispatch command can change and the node identity does not distinguish.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — s17 carries one deliverable (make `queue_dispatch` merge steerable fields onto an existing pointer, with the field list named once as a constant); naming the constant is part of that change, not a second goal.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the plan declares `plan-informs: a-queue-holds-the-whole-plan` and no section declares an in-plan `depends-on`/`gates`, so s17 carries no relationship that is missing or misdirected.
